product.p_description: Paracetamol is widely used to reduce fever and relieve mild to moderate pain such as headache, toothache, and body aches. Suitable for adults and children when used as directed.
Ibuprofen is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) used to reduce inflammation, pain, and fever. Commonly used for muscle pain, arthritis, and menstrual cramps.
Low-dose Aspirin is used as a blood thinner to prevent heart attacks and strokes by reducing blood clot formation.
Amoxicillin is a penicillin-type antibiotic used to treat bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, urinary tract infections, and skin infections.
Azithromycin is a macrolide antibiotic used to treat infections including bronchitis, pneumonia, and sexually transmitted diseases.
Omeprazole reduces stomach acid production and is used to treat acid reflux, GERD, and stomach ulcers.
Metformin helps control blood sugar levels in patients with type 2 diabetes by improving insulin sensitivity.
Amlodipine is used to treat high blood pressure and chest pain (angina) by relaxing blood vessels and improving blood flow.
Lisinopril is an ACE inhibitor used to manage hypertension and heart failure by relaxing blood vessels.
Atorvastatin helps lower cholesterol and triglyceride levels, reducing the risk of heart disease and stroke.
Vitamin D3 supports calcium absorption, bone strength, and immune system health. Commonly used to prevent or treat Vitamin D deficiency.
Vitamin B Complex contains essential B vitamins that help boost energy levels, improve metabolism, and support brain and nerve function.
Vitamin C is a powerful antioxidant that helps strengthen immunity, improve skin health, and protect against infections.
Calcium Carbonate is used to prevent and treat calcium deficiency, supporting strong bones and teeth.
Iron supplement used to treat or prevent iron deficiency anemia by improving red blood cell production.
Zinc helps boost immunity, supports wound healing, and plays a vital role in cell growth and metabolism.
Probiotics support digestive health by maintaining a healthy balance of gut bacteria and improving immunity.
Omega-3 fatty acids support heart health, brain function, and reduce inflammation in the body.
Magnesium Glycinate helps with muscle relaxation, stress reduction, and better sleep quality.
Coenzyme Q10 supports energy production in cells and promotes heart health with antioxidant benefits.
Nise Tablet is a pain-relieving medicine. It is taken to treat inflammatory conditions, including joint disorders such as rheumatoid arthritis,
